appStoreApps.title: Apple App Store apps
appStoreApps.description: App Store URLs or numeric app IDs (e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/whatsapp/id310633997 or 310633997).

googlePlayApps.title: Google Play apps
googlePlayApps.description: Google Play URLs or package names (e.g. com.whatsapp).

countries.title: App Store countries
countries.description: Two-letter storefront codes for the App Store (us, gb, de, ...). Google Play uses the first one. Default: us.

language.title: Google Play language
language.description: Language code for Google Play reviews (en, de, es...).

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Newest first, or most helpful first (Google Play only; App Store gives most recent).

maxReviewsPerApp.title: Max reviews per app (per country on App Store)
maxReviewsPerApp.description: App Store allows at most 500 per country. Google Play allows thousands.

maxRating.title: Max rating
maxRating.description: Skip reviews with more stars. Set to 2 to collect only complaints.
